actual_figure_observation.text: Both full product/addition expression-tree images inspected at both widths with all boxes, connectors, dots/plus and raised indices visible.
actual_figure_observation.exercises: Image table and complete surrounding prompt inspected at both widths. Mobile full horizontal content joins left, middle and right native windows; desktop far-right 13px supplied by existing end capture.
actual_figure_observation.choices: Question 16 image table, all three candidate records and surrounding stem inspected at both widths. Mobile left/right native windows overlap.
actual_figure_observation.katex_svg_fragments: Three angle-hat SVG fragments on exercises are formula parts, not source figures; full A/B/C hat and degree-mark contexts inspected in original last screenshots.

expected_window_clipping_preserved: Mobile table image-element left captures contain white pixels beyond the narrow ancestor viewport; accepted only as left-window observations, not whole-table images.
Desktop exercises table ancestor has 13px horizontal overflow; existing original right-end region supplies its final border.
First/last and exact missing-window screenshot edges may bisect a line or figure; adjacent opened windows cover all document pixels. This is viewport clipping, not partial paint.
Mobile text final factorization and question 2 B long negative-decimal product require supported inline horizontal scrolling; newly opened right-end strips cover their full ends.
capture_failure_vs_render_defect: No blank/corrupt/partial-painted capture observed in the 64 opened files. No rendering defect found within the inspected six combinations; no rejected capture silently replaced.
status_basis: Every source PNG actually inspected via 18 exact native-copy montages; geometric coverage accounting follows that inspection and is not a substitute for it.
